events.body:
## Context

`public/index.html`: `#themeToggle` and `#closeInfoBtn` are icon-only with no label; `#countrySearch`, `#slackSearch` and three `<select>`s have no labels; sortable `<th data-sort>` respond to click only (`script.js`) with no `aria-sort`; the view buttons don't expose the selected state.

## What to do

1. Add aria-labels or visually hidden labels.
2. Make sortable headers buttons and set `aria-sort`.
3. Add `aria-pressed` to the view buttons and update it in `switchView`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] No unlabelled controls in Lighthouse/axe
- [ ] Keyboard sorting works
- [ ] Selected view announced

## How to test locally

```bash
python3 -m http.server -d blt-panini/public 8000   # then open http://localhost:8000
```
